context: E FORMS AND STRENGTHS Ondansetron hydrochloride tablets are white, round, film-coated tablets and are available in the following strengths: 4 mg – tablet debossed with “CE” on one side and “6” on the other side. 8 mg – tablet debossed with “CE” on one side and “7” on the other side.
